_comment: HELM-BIND-4 curated overlay (HELM-DATA-BINDING-BUILD-SPEC.md §5) — same 'survives the wholesale packs/ wipe+regen' pattern as ha-gate-overlay.json / chainless-packs.json. Keyed by workflow_id. compile-packs.mjs is the ONLY place that reads this file; it never writes it back. A workflow_id absent here keeps connectors:[] and BOTH connector_inputs/required_inputs ABSENT (§0.3) — its digest does not move. Adding an entry here is a deliberate, reviewed decision that a pack's kernel has no other way to get a real input value than an external fetch.

required_input.description: Google Drive file id of the daily FR 2052a inflow/outflow rows export to fetch via the google-drive.fetch connector.

pack-2052a-classify-daily._params_comment: HELM-CONNECTOR-PARAMS-2: params.fileId is the curated, compile-time-only Drive file id buildPayload reads (never a live workflow.run caller value, phil ruling 3 — see run.mjs planSteps). PLACEHOLDER pending an operator with Drive access setting the real daily-export file id; the daily export overwrites this file's CONTENT, not its id, so a fixed id is the correct curated shape once set.
